feeds.title: Core Opulence Music Blog
feeds.description: Read the Core Opulence Music Blog to learn about the soundscape experience. My name is Madison Miller and the blog is documenting my PhD journey. My goal of this PhD research is to create & share music with others. I want to bring you a place to listen to music whilst also giving you the opportunity to express your emotions through art or communication.

feeds.title: A Closer Listen » Field Recording & Soundscape
feeds.description: Check out the posts about Field Recording & Soundscape written by postrockcafe and petertracy. Since 2012, A Closer Listen has claimed a specialized niche in the music industry: instrumental album reviews! By concentrating on this above all else, we've built a healthy fanbase and a strong reputation.

feeds.title: Motion Soundscape
feeds.description: Motion Soundscape is where you can read about experimental music and sound design. Motion Soundscape is written by Igor Vasiliev. Visit the website to find out more about creating soundscapes and experimenting with sound.

feeds.title: Abstract Soundscape Blog
feeds.description: Hi Welcome to the Abstract Soundscape blog page. We hope you enjoy listening to the music tracks and viewing around the site. Visit the blog to know about soundscape. Abstract Soundscape was created by Salty for the purpose of humanity, personal growth & as a helping aid in your life journey.

feeds.title: Music of Nature Blog
feeds.description: Hi Friends! Welcome to my Music of Nature blog, an ever-growing collection of free online articles, place-based celebrations, audio postcards, photo and video studies, musings and more, all created in celebration of the voices of the natural world. My name is Lang Elliott, a nature recordist & cinematographer.
